text:
The controller in `/home/daytona/workspace/controller.py` struck the practice bag and stayed on its feet in 20 of 20 seeded runs (seeds 0–19), so the success rate is 1.0. The bag swung 34–39 cm each time, and the torso never tilted more than about 4°.

The robot plants both feet and throws a right-hand punch at the bag. The hand moves to a wind-up point 17 cm in front of the bag, then drives through the bag centre. `WholeBody` solves the pose and `ComFeedback` balances it, with a small forward lean of the centre of mass as the arm extends. If the bag hangs at positive y, it uses the left hand instead.

The 20 counted runs are all the practice setup, `0.38,-0.15,1`. The motion files are in `/home/daytona/workspace/live/`, named `final_s*.motion.json`. I also wrote `report.json` with `episodes_run` set to 20.

I also tried a few other bag positions along the way, and those are not in the 20. Bags 0.45 m or more in front, or near the centre line, were less reliable. After my last lean adjustment, `0.45,-0.05,0.9` and `0.5,-0.1,1` swung the bag less than 20 cm, which would count as failures. `0.45,0,1` still worked.

A larger forward lean reached those bags but made the robot fall on the practice bag, so I kept a milder lean that is adaptive to bag distance. I did not test the remaining positions again after that last change.
